shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat rectangular slab
band or row of repeated motifs
justification: Both surfaces are flat slabs bearing low-relief profile figures with a horizontal register band of repeated elements, but the content is otherwise unrelated: A shows a large anthropomorphic winged figure with a human-like bearded head, elaborately patterned garment and hair, one arm raised toward a stylised rosette-bearing plant, while B shows a row of small animal heads along the top, a schematic quadruped/predator, a bird-like creature with an arm-like limb and a serpentine form, with no human figure or plant. The rendering conventions differ sharply: A is densely detailed with fine incised infill of feathers, curls and fringes, whereas B is bare, blocky and schematic with plain unornamented bodies.
